approaches.label: Value Chain
approaches.description: View the AI stack as an inverted value funnel. Market outcomes and monetization sit at the wide top; each layer below narrows as capital and capability concentrate toward foundational infrastructure. This lens highlights how value flows downward through the stack and where bottlenecks form.

approaches.label: Infrastructure vs Data First
approaches.description: Compare two foundational strategies side by side. Infrastructure-first builds upward from compute and platforms; data-first elevates pipelines, models, and integration before scaling outward to applications. Use this view to reason about build order, capex, and time-to-value.

approaches.label: Human-in-the-Loop
approaches.description: Map collaboration between people and AI systems across the lifecycle. Humans set intent and govern outcomes; machines scale execution and inference. This approach emphasizes feedback loops, oversight, and shared accountability rather than a purely technical layer stack.

humanLoopSteps.title: Define intent
humanLoopSteps.summary: Humans frame goals, constraints, and success criteria.

humanLoopSteps.title: Orchestrate workflow
humanLoopSteps.summary: Systems route tasks across models, tools, and data.

humanLoopSteps.title: Review & refine
humanLoopSteps.summary: People validate outputs, correct bias, and approve releases.

humanLoopSteps.title: Deploy at scale
humanLoopSteps.summary: Infrastructure runs inference and monitors reliability.

humanLoopSteps.title: Govern outcomes
humanLoopSteps.summary: Humans audit impact, compliance, and continuous improvement.
